name: Creation Audio Labs
old_description: a manufacturer of studio quality pro-audio electronics, electric guitar and bass effect pedals.
about:
Creation Audio Labs was founded in 1996 in Lebanon, Tennessee. The company operates as a manufacturer of studio-quality pro-audio electronics and electric guitar and bass effect pedals.

The product line includes the MW1 studio tool, Redeemer onboard buffer, Holy Fire overdrive/distortion, MK.4.23 clean boost, Funkulator slap bass pedal, and the Grizzly Bass. Beyond manufacturing, the company restores vintage audio equipment, provides custom recording console modifications, and performs upgrades and repairs on professional audio sound boards. The shop also handles authorized service repairs for TL Audio, Trident A-Range, and Crown Audio amplifiers.

Creation Audio Labs serves clients worldwide and cooperates with partner shops in selected countries. Its customers include recording studios, touring musicians, and audio engineers; notable users include artists such as Peter Frampton and Ricky Skaggs. The company focuses on the professional audio, musical instrument, and vintage audio restoration markets.

The company highlights its decades of experience in studio hum elimination and vintage console restoration, positioning its modifications as a practical way to improve audio specifications in professional environments.
